needed.evidence: A green three-wheeled cargo vehicle is parked on the footway, blocking the path.
needed.suggestion: Install physical bollards along the left kerb to prevent vehicles from parking on the footway.

needed.evidence: A dense row of parked scooters and motorbikes completely blocks the footway.
needed.suggestion: Designate a specific, marked parking bay for two-wheelers on the road shoulder to clear the pedestrian path.

needed.evidence: A pedestrian is seen walking across the carriageway in the middle of the road where there is no marked crossing.
needed.suggestion: Provide a signalised pedestrian crossing at this high-demand location to allow safe passage across the multi-lane road.

needed.evidence: The visible kerbs are vertical with no indication of dropped ramps for accessibility.
needed.suggestion: Construct dropped kerbs at all entry points to the footway to improve accessibility for wheelchairs and strollers.
